parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The name of the database for which you want to disable the SQL audit feature.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB-X 1.0 instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds disable-sql-audit --drds-instance-id drds00000000000 --db-name drds_test --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DisableSqlAudit --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds00000000000 --DbName drds_test
